{"tool":"run","argument":"mkdir -p /workspace/tmp/ocr-debs /workspace/tmp/ocr-root /workspace/tmp/apt-lists/partial
apt-get -o Dir::State::lists=/workspace/tmp/apt-lists -o APT::Get::List-Cleanup=0 update > /workspace/tmp/ocr-update.log 2>&1
cd /workspace/tmp/ocr-debs
apt-get -o Dir::State::lists=/workspace/tmp/apt-lists download tesseract-ocr tesseract-ocr-eng libtesseract5 libleptonica6 libarchive13t64 libcurl4t64 > /workspace/tmp/ocr-download.log 2>&1
for pkg in *.deb; do dpkg-deb -x "$pkg" /workspace/tmp/ocr-root; done
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/workspace/tmp/ocr-root/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu
export TESSDATA_PREFIX=/workspace/tmp/ocr-root/usr/share/tesseract-ocr/5/tessdata
/workspace/tmp/ocr-root/usr/bin/tesseract --version
cd /workspace
PYTHONPATH=/workspace/vendor python - <<'PY'
import os, subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image
exe='/workspace/tmp/ocr-root/usr/bin/tesseract'
Path('diagnostics').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
for p in sorted(Path('inputs').glob('*.png')):
 im=Image.open(p).convert('RGB'); w,h=im.size
 crop=im.crop((0,0,w,int(h*.40))).resize((w*4,int(h*.40)*4))
 dest=Path('diagnostics')/(p.stem+'-chord-crop.png'); crop.save(dest)
 for mode in (6,11):
  base=str(Path('diagnostics')/(p.stem+'-ocr-'+str(mode)))
  r=subprocess.run([exe,str(dest),base,'--psm',str(mode),'tsv'],capture_output=True,text=True)
  print(p.name,'PSM',mode,'exit',r.returncode,r.stderr[:250])
  t=Path(base+'.tsv')
  if t.exists():
   import csv
   rows=list(csv.DictReader(t.open(),delimiter='\t'))
   print([(x['text'],x['conf'],x['left'],x['top'],x['width'],x['height']) for x in rows if x.get('text','').strip()])
PY","why":"Install OCR without root by extracting public Debian packages locally, then inspect enlarged above-staff OCR and bounding boxes. Missing baseline melody artifacts remain a separate blocker; this action does not claim melody preservation or measured improvement."}
